t: You're at Lansbury Lawrence Primary School, in the Lansbury Estate in Poplar, in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. The second half of the name honours Susan Lawrence, who lived from 1871 to 1947. She was a Labour Party politician and one of the earliest women to sit as a Labour MP. The school is a local primary, so this is a place for the youngest residents of the estate, carrying the name of a pioneering woman in politics.
